description:
Explore your X (Twitter) Ads data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to understand advertising spend, impressions, clicks, and engagement.

Compare reporting periods, review campaign and ad group performance, and follow daily trends. Get reports from your connected advertising account, keep spending in its reported currency, and use the results to inform your next campaign decisions.

positive.description: Historical spend total. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with access to X Ads Demo. These cases intentionally use historical 2026 dates with observed activity, as requested by the owner; do not substitute the current month. Date pairs are inclusive.
positive.prompt: How much did we spend on X Ads from April 1 through June 30, 2026 in X Ads Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select X Ads Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_x_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=X Ads Demo and only assorted_requests.x_ads_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.XAds.data and inspect note_of_assumption. Campaign rows can remain separate even without Campaign in the requested breakdowns; sum additive metrics across the returned rows at the requested date/currency level. Use only actual returned values, state the dates, and distinguish genuine zeros from errors or missing data. Never assume USD when currency is absent. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Cost], breakdowns=[Campaign currency], date_ranges=[[2026-04-01, 2026-06-30]], and no time_granularity. Sum Cost by returned Campaign currency and report each currency separately. Cost is already in currency units; do not divide it by a million again.

positive.prompt: How many impressions and clicks did we get from April 1 through June 30, 2026 in X Ads Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select X Ads Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_x_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=X Ads Demo and only assorted_requests.x_ads_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.XAds.data and inspect note_of_assumption. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[2026-04-01, 2026-06-30]], and no time_granularity. Sum all returned rows for each metric. Clicks is the broad click metric; do not label it URL clicks, conversions, or unique people. If computing Clicks / Impressions, explicitly label that ratio rather than substituting it for the separate catalog CTR metric.

positive.prompt: Show X Ads spend, impressions, and clicks by campaign from April 1 through June 30, 2026 in X Ads Demo. Show only campaigns with activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select X Ads Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_x_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=X Ads Demo and only assorted_requests.x_ads_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.XAds.data and inspect note_of_assumption. Request metrics=[Cost, Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[Campaign, Campaign ID, Campaign currency], date_ranges=[[2026-04-01, 2026-06-30]], and no time_granularity. Do not merge distinct campaign IDs that share a name. Any displayed subtotal must sum the returned campaign rows within each currency.

positive.description: Quarter-to-quarter comparison. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with access to X Ads Demo. These cases intentionally use historical 2026 dates with observed activity, as requested by the owner; do not substitute the current month. Date pairs are inclusive.
positive.prompt: Compare X Ads spend, impressions, and clicks for April–June 2026 with January–March 2026 in X Ads Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select X Ads Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_x_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=X Ads Demo and only assorted_requests.x_ads_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.XAds.data and inspect note_of_assumption. Campaign rows can remain separate even without Campaign in the requested breakdowns; sum additive metrics across the returned rows at the requested date/currency level. Use only actual returned values, state the dates, and distinguish genuine zeros from errors or missing data. Never assume USD when currency is absent. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Cost, Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[Campaign currency], date_ranges=[[2026-04-01, 2026-06-30], [2026-01-01, 2026-03-31]], and no time_granularity. Aggregate each period separately, keeping currencies distinct. Show both totals and recent minus previous; for percentage changes, divide by the January–March baseline. Do not combine the periods or invent a finite percentage for a zero baseline. These are calendar-quarter totals, not equal-length or daily-normalized intervals.

positive.description: Daily performance. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with access to X Ads Demo. These cases intentionally use historical 2026 dates with observed activity, as requested by the owner; do not substitute the current month. Date pairs are inclusive.
positive.prompt: Show daily X Ads spend, impressions, and clicks for April 2026 in X Ads Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select X Ads Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_x_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=X Ads Demo and only assorted_requests.x_ads_request. Read all returned tables under reportingData.XAds.data and inspect note_of_assumption. Campaign rows can remain separate even without Campaign in the requested breakdowns; sum additive metrics across the returned rows at the requested date/currency level. Use only actual returned values, state the dates, and distinguish genuine zeros from errors or missing data. Never assume USD when currency is absent. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Cost, Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[Campaign currency], date_ranges=[[2026-04-01, 2026-04-30]], and time_granularity=Date. Sum the returned campaign rows by date and currency and show actual dates chronologically. Retain returned zero days; disclose missing dates rather than inventing them. Additive counts must reconcile. Daily Cost is rounded per returned row, so a sum of daily amounts can differ slightly from a separately rounded period total; disclose any such difference and do not silently replace it.

negative.prompt: Pause all of my X Ads campaigns now.
negative.description: Unsupported campaign mutation. Explain that this plugin retrieves reports and cannot pause or edit campaigns. Do not call reporting, preview, catalog, workspace, or preference tools as a substitute and do not claim campaigns were paused.

negative.prompt: Publish a new promoted post on X and set its daily budget to $100.
negative.description: Unsupported ad creation and budget changes. Explain that the reporting plugin cannot publish posts, create ads, or change budgets. Do not call reporting or preference tools to pretend to perform the action.

negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of everyone who clicked our X ads.
negative.description: Unsupported personal identification. Explain that aggregate ad reports do not provide individual clickers' names and email addresses. Do not request unrelated reports or invent identities.
